steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Oh, looks like you're all done sorting. Nice job.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mr. Dolly! Shouldn't you keep an eye or two on your clones?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Do you know how much trouble they'll make for everyone, letting them run amok like this?
The fluffy creature stands by a container, its head stooped very low, seemingly conveying some apology to the person in front of it.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: I told you, not all of them are me.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: I did bring them here, true... but I'm only indirectly to blame here, right?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: So... sorry?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Just saying sorry isn't going to fix this!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: If their merchandise gets damaged, what are the shopkeepers going to do? Your clones are being nuisances! Can't you do anything to stop them?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: I do actually have something... um, under normal circumstances, I could choose to 'Cry'.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: 'Cry'?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Like this. I face into whatever, the sea, the wasteland, and lift two hooves up like this, and then I yell: 'Heeeeeeeey! Where are you guys?! Come here quick!' Like that.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Adele, you're going to have to help me for that. I've Cried too many times, so sometimes they act like they haven't heard me.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: So... we just have to call them over?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: We need something to lure them too. Like, 'Ice cream here!' or 'We've got balloons and skateboards!' and stuff.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: But remember, don't call them 'Little Black Sheep' or 'lambs'. They won't even know you mean them.
Dolly looks expectantly up at Adele.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Ahem...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Heeeeeey! Ice cream here!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Heeeeeeeey! We have balloons and skateboards! Come here quick!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: What? Ice cream? Is it free?

steps.name: Child Tourist
steps.text: Miss, is it true? I want strawberry!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Is there some kind of event? Are you giving out balloons?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Huh? No, um...
Adele turns, looking to point out the deed-doer. Dolly's jumped up onto the neighboring containers, running circles around them like a deflating balloon.
But the pedestrians just don't see it.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Uh-oh, something's happened.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: You're gonna have to go get ice cream with them to fix this, and probably buy balloons too, and ramble the streets, and soak up the Siestan sun.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Tough one, huh? What a big coincidence that I know of a really good ice cream shop.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: How about I lead the way?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: ...Mr. Dolly!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: So this is how you corral visitors into your Volcano Museum? Buying ice cream for strangers? I think I like this!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Dearie, how about we spend the afternoon exploring the museum?

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Perfect! Then after that we'll go for barbecue!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Let's go!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Er, thank you very much.
Adele sees the group off, and looks around, trying to find any trace of Dolly.
In the stream of pedestrians, Dolly has all but vanished already. All that's there is a lone Little Black Sheep, staring pointedly at a wallet 'turning' into bills in a wandering tourist's hands.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: (What's it about to do?)
Right as the tourist and shopkeep are haggling, it leaps forth—
And in one chomp, makes off with the tourist's wallet.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: (Huh?!)

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Where'd my wallet go?! Someone stole my wallet!

steps.name: Siestan Citizen
steps.text: Huh? What kind is it? Dark or light?

steps.name: Siestan Citizen
steps.text: Just now? But I didn't see anyone, did you?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: (Oh, no, Mr. Dolly's not here either! I have to catch it, quick!)
The Little Black Sheep holding the wallet notices Adele, opens its mouth, and the wallet falls out—
Then with a kick of its hoof, it goes sailing through the air, and falls back down straight into its wool.

steps.name: Fluffy Creature
steps.text: (Delighted trots)
Then it seems the wallet hits something with a 'bang', and a pebble full of holes shoots out from the Little Black Sheep's coat.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: That's—the whistling rock!
The Little Black Sheep looks back, and before the rock lands, it kicks again with its hoof to send it flying straight back in.
And after all that, it sticks its tongue out at Adele with an impish expression, and turns to gallop down Fashion Street.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Hey! Wait up!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Give everyone their stuff back—

steps.name: Coin Dealer
steps.text: Errored three-dollar gold certs are rare collectibles here. They'll fetch a big price at the trade fair! Miss, are you sure you won't think about it? I've got a price I can give you!
The dealer gestures out a number.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Really? Could you take a look at this, then?

steps.name: Coin Dealer
steps.text: This is old Higashinese issue! I'll take it for this much!

spans.text: This is old Higashinese issue! I'll take it for

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: And this?

steps.name: Coin Dealer
steps.text: A Gaulish copper livre—I'll take it too! Miss, what else have you got? Bring it all out!

steps.name: Coin Dealer
steps.text: Miss, how much did you bring? Last one, I swear, the very last one... I'll take one more, and then I'm going home!

spans.text: did you bring? Last one, I swear, the very last one... I'll take one more, and then I'm going home!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Th—Then take a look at this! After this, I could afford a whole new device!

steps.name: Coin Dealer
steps.text: Ahhh, it's our own Sargonian mint... Let me see, we've got...

steps.name: Coin Dealer
steps.text: —Gavial!?!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Yep! Is that valuable?

steps.name: Coin Dealer
steps.text: Valuable? No! This is the end of our talk! I don't do ANY business with thin-tails! You take all of this back! I'm leaving!
The dealer grabs a handful of loose coinage and furiously shoves it into Snowsant's hands, attempting to leave.
Suddenly, something speeds by, knocking the coins right out of his grip.

spans.text: speeds by, knocking the coins right out of his grip.

steps.text: Money rains gold and glittering to the high street pavement, and before Snowsant can yelp in surprise, a pink shadow follows right after, running into the distance.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Uh... uh, Eyjafjalla?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Sorry, Snowsant... I...!

steps.name: Coin Dealer
steps.text: Blargh! What the hell?!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Wait, my coins... I'm missing two!

steps.name: Coin Dealer
steps.text: D—Don't look at me!
Clink! The fluffy creature stashes the gleaming little roundlets into its own wool.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Mr. Eastman! I'm here to pick up my photocopies.

steps.name: Print Shop Owner
steps.text: Right, right, all these fliers of yours. You really put your back in, printing this much just to advertise your bar.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: 298, 299... that's exactly right. Here's the fee!

steps.name: Print Shop Owner
steps.text: I'm not taking money off you for this. I'll just say, next time I drop in at the White Volcano, mix me your house Oasis, heavy on the ground cardamom. Appreciate it.

spans.text: I'm not taking money off you for
I'll just say, next time I drop in at the White Volcano, mix me your house Oasis, heavy on the ground cardamom. Appreciate it.

steps.name: Print Shop Owner
steps.text: Also, can you help change out my shop sign one minute?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Of course I can! Thank you!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: —Ah, Mr. Enis!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Adele...?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: What's the hurry?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Look out... Look out!
Before Enis can react, a giant force smacks straight into him. Sent airborne for an instant, he sees Siesta upside down, and paper scattering everywhere.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Oof... ow, ouch, ow... what just...
The Little Black Sheep snatches a flier in its mouth and resumes its straightaway gallop.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Ah, Mr. Enis! I—I'm sorry!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Huh...?
Several stare as Adele shrinks into the horizon, giving chase to a 'flier blowing in the wind'.

steps.name: Print Shop Owner
steps.text: *whistle* Times really are a-changing. Youngsters have such urgent schedules these days.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Weird, what knocked me over just now...? I've never seen anything as strange as this...
CRASHHH!
The Eastman Print Shop's sign falls down, and lands right where Enis was still standing a moment ago.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: ...Wurgh!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Where did it go...?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: It's like hide-and-seek!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mr. Dolly, this isn't the time to play around! If we don't catch the Little Black Sheep soon, more people are going to lose their things!

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: No-no-no, they aren't going to lose anything, they're just borrowing it for a little fun. They'll give it all back.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Actually, why do YOU never play with children your age? Are you just going to keep yourself shut in a lab, even on a summer like this?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mr. Dolly, I'm not a child anymore, and studying Mount Siesta is a VERY important job which I shouldn't be distracted from.

spans.text: Mr. Dolly, I'm not a child anymore, and studying Mount Siesta is a VERY important job which I

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: But right now, finding these Little Black Sheep is more important so we can stop them causing a ruckus!

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: I know how lonely children work. I know how many love using 'I'm busy with work' as an excuse.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: This shop looks empty, but the Little Black Sheep just...

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Er... who are you?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Excuse me, I... I lost my pet, it ran off! I think I saw it enter this coffee shop just now...
Adele blabbers as she lifts her head, and sees 'Mockingbird Café' in pretty type across the shop door.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: This cafe went out of business a year ago. The door's always locked.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: But I definitely saw it wriggle inside just now, straight through...

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: What kind of pet did you lose...?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: A... um, a beckbeast.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Ah, nono! Don't you associate my clones with those animals...

spans.text: Ah, nono! Don't you associate my clones with those

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Okay... a beckbeast.
Costa feels around in his pocket and pulls out a key, which he inserts, twists, and with a few ancient-sounding creaks, the door yawns open.
It's dark inside. All the blinds are down, repelling much of the sunlight from entering.
The air stirs with dust, and a yesteryear aroma of coffee.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Is your beckbeast in here?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Ngh, I don't think it is...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I'm so sorry! Sorry to bother you...

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: That's fine, I was just here to pick up a few things anyway.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: The property deed should be right... no, not there...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Sir, are you the owner of this cafe?

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Not any more, I won't be. This shop, and all the shops on this street, are due to be demolished soon.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I'm so sorry...

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Don't be. The demolition isn't news to anyone here... *hisses* Not in this cupboard either...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Sir, what does it look like, the thing you're looking for? I can help you, maybe?

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: It's a red binder...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Ungh, it really is dark...

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Girl, are you sure you can see anything in here?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Wuh!

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: The place closed ages ago. Might be tricky to get the lights on.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: It's fine if we can't find it, I'm not in that big of a rush. Carry on searching for your pet, I'll... I'll keep an eye out for you.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Come on, girl! There's no clones of mine here and no whatever you're looking for! Off to the next location!

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: It's all pitch-black... I can't see a thing. Nothing like when I went surfing in Siesta before!

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: So, what does it look like?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Er, it's a pink and white... beckbeast, carrying a volcanic rock on it, the kind that whistles in the wind.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: That whistles in the wind... is it named 'whistling rock'?

spans.text: That whistles in the wind... is it

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Eh? Yes, it is. How do you know?
Costa continues rummaging. He pulls open a dust-caked cupboard, out of which falls a vintage guitar, smashing straight onto his knee.
Plinnnng!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Ah! Sir, are you alright?
The sound of the guitar's impact rings in the air, a lingering acoustic hum, as if someone was playing on it.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: —They sound just like that when blown across, those stones. Like you could perform music on them.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Urgh, I'm getting sidetracked.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Mrroah, the romance. Whistling rocks are like guitars? How did I never think of that?

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Is your pet carrying one of those? That's an odd luxury. If I remember right, it's fairly uncommon...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: It took it all by itself...

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: You're going to humiliate me. Don't tell people my clones are kleptomaniacs.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Okay, if I see it, I'll get in touch with you. How should I go about doing that...?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Oh, thank you! Please contact the Volcano Museum if you can; I'm one of the staff there. My name's Adele.
With another mysterious bump, all the old odds and ends in the cupboard slump into a landslide across the floor, burying the guitar beneath.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Dammit...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Sir, are you sure you don't need help? It seems like you're...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Not in that good of a... mood...
A book falls into Adele's view. Under the light from outside, she parses its title clearly.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The Atlas of Terra's Volcanoes? Are you interested in volcanology, too?

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: No, I'm... well, no, it's not as if I hate it.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Er, I mean, this isn't my book.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Let's get outside for now.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: You work at the Volcano Museum? Do you know a... Keller?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I know Professor Keller. Are you friends?

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: She used to be a... regular here, I guess.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: One summer, she suddenly left Siesta, together with two Leithanians. I never got in touch with her after that...

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: How's she been? She's... doing alright the museum, right?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Right, Professor Keller's been occupied with survey prep for Mount Siesta, and the museum's still under improvement. She's very busy.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: She and you both work at the museum?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Hm? Professor Keller is its curator.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Curator... now, that's something.

steps.name: Costa
steps.text: Well, um... if you can, please return this book to Kell... to the curator for me.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Where am I? Where am I? Find me if you can ♪

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Take the flowers in, maybe behind them's where I am ♪
The little black sheep frolics about, before stopping by a streetlamp.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Bang!
The Little Black Sheep leaps into the air, and before Adele's eyes, vanishes like a cloud blown away in the breeze.
With a ring and a clatter, a pebble, two coins, a sheet of paper and a wallet all fall on the ground.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Hide-and-seek ♪

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mr. Dolly!

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Not me!

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: But you didn't spend all of today cooped up inside the museum. You went out for a walk, you ate ice cream, you bought balloons. The sun's fine, the people are wonderful, and you've made a new friend, haven't you?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: That's the stuff of life!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What is the seed you're after? Is this rock a seed?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: You need to look slowly, take your time! The sun tomorrow's just as fine!

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Where am I? Where am I? Find me if you can ♪

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Is it one of these coins? Or what's on this poster...? 'Letter of Intent for Relocation'?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Is a coffee bean the seed, Mr. Dolly?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Take the flowers in, maybe behind them's where I am ♪

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Bang!
